description: This file defines the EmailMessage entity class for the Fineract project. It models email message records with attributes such as recipient details, campaign info, status, and message content, and includes factory methods for creating instances and update logic.

classes.name: EmailMessage
classes.description: Entity class representing an email message scheduled for sending, with various associations and status information.

methods.name: pendingEmail
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new EmailMessage instance with 'pending' status based on provided parameters.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EmailMessage instance with specified status type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the message content if changed in the given JsonCommand and returns the list of changed parameters.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the email message status is pending.

methods.name: isSent
methods.description: Checks if the email message status indicates it has been sent.
